name: vscode-ai-commit
description: Generate a commit message from your staged changes with the Claude Code or Codex CLI, using your existing subscription.

aiCommit.provider.description: Which local CLI generates the message. Both run under your own subscription login, no API key.

aiCommit.claudePath.description: Path to the Claude Code CLI. Use an absolute path if the extension cannot find it.

aiCommit.codexPath.description: Path to the Codex CLI. Use an absolute path if the extension cannot find it.

aiCommit.claudeModel.description: Model alias passed to claude --model. Empty means your Claude Code default.

aiCommit.codexModel.description: Model passed to codex exec -m. Empty means your Codex default.

aiCommit.codexArgs.description: Extra arguments for codex exec, inserted before the prompt.

aiCommit.language.description: Language of the commit description. The Conventional Commits type and scope stay English either way.

aiCommit.includeBody.description: Add a short bullet body under the subject line.

aiCommit.diffSource.description: staged: only staged changes. stagedThenAll: fall back to the whole working tree when nothing is staged.

aiCommit.maxDiffChars.description: Truncate the patch above this many characters. The file list stays complete.

aiCommit.excludeGlobs.description: Paths kept out of the patch body. They still show up in the file list.

aiCommit.timeoutSeconds.description: Kill the CLI after this many seconds.
